 Lifestyle Your Horoscope for the Week of Oct 23
 UPDATED Oct 22, 2026, 11:35 PM
 See what the stars have in store for you... Photo: tabla! Aries
 You could clash with a colleague. A repair bill will disrupt your budget. Keep written records.
 Taurus
 A festive shopping bargain proves less attractive at checkout. Your partner questions your integrity. Compare prices before buying.
 Gemini
 Your AI-generated report may contain an embarrassing mistake. A former classmate proposes a business partnership. Check facts and financial expectations.
 Cancer
 A WhatsApp message will spark a big argument. Your child’s school expenses rise unexpectedly. Discuss priorities without blaming anyone.
 Leo
 A promising job interview gets postponed without explanation. Someone you recently dated becomes distant. Resist sending repeated follow-up messages.
 Virgo
 A property agent pushes for an immediate decision. Hidden maintenance costs emerge. Inspect everything before signing any agreement.
 Libra
 A sibling or friend may request another loan. Review automatic payments and establish financial boundaries.
 Scorpio
 Your car could develop a troubling noise. Household repairs may require costly replacements. Seek expert opinion on financial matters.
 Sagittarius
 A cheap holiday package excludes baggage and airport transfers. You may disagree with your spouse over a restaurant booking. Calculate the actual costs before agreeing to a deal.
 Capricorn
 A delayed freelance payment complicates your monthly commitments. Your manager announces another workplace restructuring.
 Aquarius
 An unfamiliar caller knows your full name and recent purchases. Stick to official channels while dealing with a PR representative.
 Pisces
 A relative unexpectedly arrives during your carefully planned weekend. Persistent headaches interfere with work. Seek medical advice for your heel problem.
